blurb: Whole-person Acupuncture care, traditional herbal medicine, and Homeopathy, with subspecialties in Fertility, Women's Health, and Neuroacupuncture.
long:
In her Oriental Medicine clinic, Sybil focuses on gentle, intuitive Japanese styles of practice. The Japanese tradition emphasizes hair-thin needles, shallow insertions, moxibustion (a warming treatment involving artemesia herb), and extensive palpation techniques. This type of acupuncture benefits all but is especially welcome to those who fear needling or who are extremely sensitive.
Japanese acupuncture also features an herbal medicine tradition, called Kampo, based on the classics. Sophisticated palpation of the abdomen is key to determining a patient’s precise pattern of disharmony and to prescribing the most appropriate herbal formula for each individual.
The AcuGraph system is an invaluable aid in your treatment at Lotus Wellspring Healthcare. A simple test that involves touching a probe to specific points on your wrists, ankles, fingers, or toes shows you—in vivid color and real time—which energy pathways and organs are out of balance and how best to bring everything back into balance.

Rather than adding more to an already overwhelming to-do list, she focuses on small changes that decrease stress, increase resilience, and improve overall well-being.
long:
Melissa works with adults who feel overwhelmed by work, health challenges, caregiving demands, or the cumulative stress of everyday life. Many of her clients are managing significant responsibilities and appear to be functioning well, but feel burned out, constantly on edge, or like their current pace is unsustainable.

Coaching is individualized to each client’s needs and may focus on practical stress management and resilience strategies that help regulate the nervous system, shift unhelpful thought patterns, manage difficult emotions, engage in what feels fulfilling, and create structures that make it easier to focus on what matters most.

Melissa’s goal is to help clients identify what will make the greatest difference in their lives and translate that into practical, sustainable action. She offers individual virtual coaching as well as stress management and resilience workshops and programs for healthcare organizations, universities, professional groups, and workplaces.
